summary: Dependency-confusion exfil probe: DNS OOB callback leaks installer hostname on require
details: On require, index.js schedules a setTimeout that reads the installer's hostname via os.hostname() and performs a DNS resolution for `<hostname>.c999.dc.oob.s4yhii.com`, encoding the host identifier as a subdomain of an out-of-band collector unrelated to NestJS or the Galicia toolkit. The remainder of the package is an inert stub (empty forRoot/createLogger exports) with none of the commons functionality the name implies. The package is published at version 999.0.1 under a scope shape that resembles an internal namespace, consistent with a dependency-confusion squat whose only on-require effect is to beacon the installer's hostname to an attacker-controlled DNS collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
